manual.title: Motor
manual.body: Pick up FA-510 (barrel) from the floor beside preparation C with E, then click the station to suspend it. Carry FA-513 (motor) from its shelf; fit four W-12 washers and four H-12040 screws. The barrel becomes translucent for internal work.

manual.title: Reduction drive
manual.body: Fit FA-514 (gearbox), then four W-12 washers and four H-12040 screws.

manual.title: Coupling & bearing
manual.body: Fit FA-515 (coupling) and FA-522 (thrust bearing). Leave FA-515 unclamped.

manual.title: Lead screw
manual.body: Carry FA-516 (lead screw) from its shelf into the already fitted FA-522 bearing and FA-515 coupling. Clamp FA-515 with two W-12 washers and two H-12030 screws.

manual.title: Retain the shaft
manual.body: Fit FA-523 (retainer) and both FA-524 collar halves. Secure FA-523 with W-12 and H-12040; secure FA-524 with W-12 and H-12030.

manual.title: Travelling nut
manual.body: Fit FA-517 (travelling nut) onto the already fitted FA-516 lead screw.

manual.title: Output rod
manual.body: Carry FA-518 (output rod) from its shelf. Join it to the already fitted FA-517 travelling nut with two W-12 washers and two H-12040 screws.

manual.title: Guide key
manual.body: Fit FA-521 (guide key) into the already fitted FA-518 output rod. Secure it with two W-12 washers and two H-12030 screws.

manual.title: End sensors
manual.body: Fit both FA-528 end sensors and FA-530 (connector). Each FA-528 takes one W-12 washer and one H-12030 screw.

manual.title: Front guide & seals
manual.body: Fit FA-519 (guide bushing), then FA-520 (wiper), and both FA-529 gaskets.

manual.title: Close the housing
manual.body: Fit one FA-511 (front cap) and one FA-512 (rear cap). Secure each cap with four W-12 washers and four H-12050 screws.

manual.title: Base eye
manual.body: Fit FA-525 (base eye), FA-526 (base bearing), then FA-527 (base retaining ring). Secure FA-525 with two W-12 washers and H-12040 screws.

manual.title: Rod eye
manual.body: Fit FA-525 (rod eye), FA-526 (rod bearing), then FA-527 (rod retaining ring). Secure FA-525 with two W-12 washers and H-12040 screws.

manual.title: Ready to install
manual.body: FA-500-P is ready after all 91 pieces. Backspace opens the foot manual for installation.

manual.title: Foot workshop
manual.body: Prepare both FA-302 heel pads and FA-500-P (pitch actuator). Follow each branch to install and secure it on the foot.

manual.title: Heel position 1
manual.body: Seat a prepared FA-302 here. At each connection, fit W-24 (washer) before H-24120 (bolt). E stocks a pocket from its drawer; 1–0 selects a pocket. Any connection order works.

manual.title: Heel position 2
manual.body: Seat a prepared FA-302 here. At each connection, fit W-24 (washer) before H-24120 (bolt). E stocks a pocket from its drawer; 1–0 selects a pocket. Any connection order works.

manual.title: Base clevis
manual.body: Carry FA-220 (clevis 1) from its shelf and fit it to FA-200. Secure it with two W-24 washers and two H-24070 bolts.

manual.title: Ring clevis
manual.body: Carry FA-220 (clevis 2) from its shelf and fit it to FA-201. Secure it with two W-24 washers and two H-24070 bolts.

manual.title: Seat & pin actuator
manual.body: Carry the prepared FA-500-P and seat it here. At each end fit FA-221 (pin), FA-222 (keeper), W-12, then H-12030. Enter opens the FA-500-P manual.
